text:
nima: Heads-up: since ~03:15 UTC some onboarding webhooks for trial tenants have been delayed and a subset received duplicate profile creations. Observed in US-east and EU-west. Need quick customer note + remediation offer.
alex (eng): Investigating. Looks like a backpressure bump in profile-worker causing retries without idempotency. Pushing a guard that checks existing profile_id before create. ETA ~18m.
ops-bot: deploy started by alex: fixes/idempotency-check v0.1 (canary 20%).
claire (revops): i'll calculate credits. Suggest $3 flat for small trials, $25 cap for larger trial accounts impacted in the window. Will post CSV when ready.
pat (acct exec): Flagging two renewal-sensitive trials: NovaGrid and HelixHealth. Please high-touch them if impacted. I'll join outreach.
alex (eng): Canary looks stable; errors down ~70% on canary hosts. Rolling out to 100%. Short-term customer mitigation: consumers can dedupe by external_batch_id or run the attached SQL snippet to remove duplicate profiles.
ops-bot: rollout complete: fixes/idempotency-check v0.1 successfully deployed.
nima: Draft outreach (short): "Hi — we detected and resolved an issue affecting onboarding deliveries for some trial accounts between 03:15–03:40 UTC. We've deployed a fix and ingestion is back to normal. If you saw duplicated profiles we can run a cleanup for you; we also offer a complimentary 30-minute onboarding healthcheck and a credit. We'll follow up with credit confirmation within 72 hours. Reply here or book time: <cal.link/30>"
claire (revops): csv ready, attaching totals. Credits will be issued automatically; confirmations within 72 hours.
pat (acct exec): Please route NovaGrid and HelixHealth to me for high-touch outreach. Include me on the send.
alex (eng): Short RCA blurb: "Cause: downstream profile-worker backpressure exposed lack of idempotency; Fix: add pre-create existence check and improved retry/backoff; Mitigation: rollback duplicate writes and offer dedupe script."
nima: Plan: 1) Send segmented outreach within 45 minutes. 2) Revops to confirm credits within 72h. 3) Pat to handle flagged renewals. I'll collate replies and share an exec summary. Close loop on any urgent replies.
ops-bot: incident closed: fixes/idempotency-check v0.1 fully rolled out.
